credentialScanScope: Static scan of every archived file for private-key, bearer-authorization and long OpenAI key patterns. Runtime performance fixture does not create authentication credentials. Not a substitute for prior HTTP token-aware scanning.

loadObservation.scope: 30-second process-name/CPU snapshots and per-label preflight; ordinary desktop remains active. Not continuous proof of exclusive hardware or fixed clocks.

scope: Same-machine finite Runtime performance and logging-overhead acceptance; prior HTTP/regression evidence remains attached to its original run. Main 500ms result does not cover every startup/seek/monitoring sample.
